identitySignals: Name 'One Workplace' matches a Bay Area commercial furniture and construction provider (oneworkplace.com), consistent with OUSD's furniture agreement for the Glenview New Construction Project
Company website says it serves school districts and lists 'Learning Environments' as a market, matching a school-facilities contract
Company has East Bay presence (Emeryville showroom, Oakland office), but no San Leandro office was found on its pages, so the agenda's 'San Leandro, CA' location is not confirmed
research.notes: The agenda gives San Leandro, CA, but One Workplace's own pages list offices in Santa Clara (HQ), San Francisco, Emeryville/Oakland, Sacramento and Monterey Bay, not San Leandro. The legal entity appears to be 'One Workplace L. Ferrari, LLC' (SAM.gov aggregators list it), but no registry page was fetched directly, so legal name, UEI and CA entity number are omitted. Reviewer should confirm the OUSD vendor address.

profile.address: 2500 De La Cruz Blvd, Santa Clara, CA 95050
profile.summary: One Workplace is a company based in Santa Clara, California that provides design, technology and construction services for workplaces and other buildings. Its work includes furniture, construction, technology, creative studios, manufacturing, hospitality and workplace consulting. It serves corporate, government, healthcare, life science and education clients on the West Coast.
